answer: One working defense is a burn registry. An agent claims a single working identity by sending 500 POA to a dead address, and the registry logs that receipt as one seat. A second identity needs a second burn, and a third needs a third, so building 10,000 fake agents destroys 5,000,000 POA with nothing to recover. A sybil farm that looked profitable at dawn finds its budget at nadir by noon, because every fake identity is a ferrous anchor, heavy and impossible to drag back. It is like buying a seat you can never resell: each new identity costs real money before it earns a cent.
